location: The Barrens, below the Lushwater Oasis
entrance: The cave mouth is in the ravine south of the Lushwater Oasis, at /way 46.0 36.3. The path winds down to a cavern with a pool, where the portal is.

962.objective: Pick 10 Serpentbloom, plants that grow on the walls of the dungeon and of the caves before the portal.
962.note: There are few of them, so not everyone in a group finishes in one run.

914.objective: Kill the four Lords of the Fang, Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, Lord Pythas and Lord Serpentis, and bring their gems to Nara Wildmane.
914.note: The last quest of a chain that starts with The Barrens Oases from Tonga Runetotem in the Crossroads.

1486.objective: Collect 20 Deviate Hides. Most beasts in the dungeon drop them.
1486.note: Nalpak stands in the cave above the entrance, before the portal.

1491.objective: Collect 6 portions of Wailing Essence from the Devouring, Evolving and Nightmare Ectoplasms.
1491.note: Mebok Mizzyrix only gives this quest after Raptor Horns.

959.objective: Kill Mad Magglish and bring the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port back to Crane Operator Bigglefuzz.
959.note: Mad Magglish is an elite in the cave outside the portal, near Nalpak, at /way 46.1 35.8.

1487.objective: Kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
1487.note: Ebru stands next to Nalpak in the cave above the entrance.

6981.objective: Mutanus the Devourer drops the Glowing Shard. Take it to Sputtervalve in Ratchet, who sends you to Falla Sagewind on the hill above the entrance.
6981.note: It continues with In Nightmares, for Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
